thread:
James (AE): inbound security questionnaire from OrionNet — they uploaded a CAIQ v4 and checked BYOK + SOC2. Link: https://drive.redwood/secforms/ORION-CAIQ.pdf Please triage and assign owner. Need ETA by EOD Thu.
Rachel (PS&S): @James I can take the answers. Quick Q: do they want SOC2 evidence attached or just narrative for controls?
James (AE): they checked "yes" for SOC2 evidence. Pilot timeline: 2-week pilot starting 4/10. Also asked for committed capacity discount calc — will need pricing input.
Mike (InfoSec): flagging: BYOK + on-prem asks mean we need a key custody diagram and HSM/KMS details. Customer must provide key flow and policy.
Anna (Sales Ops): FYI pricing — for a 2-week pilot we typically do credits not discounts. If they convert within 30 days we can apply a credit. cc @James
Rachel (PS&S): cool. I'll start drafting answers. Can someone move the CAIQ to the secure bucket? Prefer not to leave on public Drive.
questionnaire-bot: uploaded ORION-CAIQ.pdf to s3://redwood-secure/questionnaires/3632105432/ — access logging enabled.
James (AE): thanks bot. @Rachel @Mike plan: Rachel owns questionnaire responses, Mike handles KMS/arch signoff, I'll coordinate pricing and ask customer for missing artifacts.
Mike (InfoSec): ok. James, please request this minimal set from the customer:
```
Required: key custody diagram, KMS type (HSM/KMS), rotation policy
Optional: attestation from third-party HSM provider
```
Rachel (PS&S): ETA for answers draft: Tue EOD. Who will review SOC2 attachments if they send them?
Anna (Sales Ops): Security team should review evidence. If they request our SOC2 report we route through Legal and the secure vault.
James (AE): noted. Rachel, mark the fields that need evidence and I'll request them from Orion.
Rachel (PS&S): will do and flag any partial/no answers for risk.
Mike (InfoSec): if they push for on-prem deployment note our checklist: network peering, audit log export, restricted egress, SLA adjustments. See internal link.
Mike (InfoSec): https://docs.redwood/internal/onprem-checklist — reviewers: @Rachel @Anna
Rachel (PS&S): one blocker: they require E2E encryption at rest with customer-managed keys. We support BYOK but need the step sequence for CAIQ. I'll draft language.
Anna (Sales Ops): Pricing note: Dedicated/Private changes the quote materially. James, hold pricing until security confirms deployment model.
James (AE): agreed. Next steps: Rachel draft by Tue EOD, Mike KMS signoff by Wed, James follow up on pricing. Tagging @Lena if SOC2/evidence is requested.
Lena (Legal): I'll standby for SOC2/evidence upload process. We'll provide a redacted report via secure vault if requested.
Rachel (PS&S): uploaded answers draft to s3://redwood-secure/questionnaires/3632105432/answers-v1.md — requesting @Mike review.
Mike (InfoSec): reviewing now. Noted a missing detail on token storage encryption — adding comment to answers file.
James (AE): thanks. Follow-up call scheduled Thu 10am PT with Orion — I'll send calendar invite.
Anna (Sales Ops): :thumbsup: please include expected decision date in the invite.
questionnaire-bot: reminder: thread idle for >24h will be auto-escalated to security-queue.
Rachel (PS&S): bumping for visibility — draft ready for final review, tagging @Mike @Lena
Mike (InfoSec): final signoff given. No blockers for pilot with BYOK pending customer key flow diagram.
James (AE): last_message: customer confirmed they will deliver key diagram by Tue 5pm PST — moving status to "in-progress".
